name: Condensed
rule: Exchange Counter for Potency without increasing status budget.

name: Lingering
rule: Exchange Potency for Counter.

name: Stable
rule: Prevent the first two natural Potency-decay events.

name: Accelerated
rule: Execute one status tick immediately and consume 2 Counter.

name: Delayed
rule: Release after two turns with 25% more Potency.

name: Contagious
rule: On death transfer half remaining Potency and Counter once.

name: Embedded
rule: On cleanse deal 25% remaining budget as True Damage, capped at 20.

name: Threshold
rule: Apply only under the selected HP or debuff-count condition.

name: Ignition
rule: Consume 1..5 Burn Counter for proportional Magical Fire Damage.

name: Kindling
rule: Store half Burn Potency lost, capped at 20, for the next Burn.

name: Flashover
rule: Copy 30% Burn Potency to at most three secondary targets.

name: Cremation
rule: On death explode for half remaining Burn budget, capped at 40.

name: White Flame
rule: Fire Damage -20%; Shield Damage +50%.

name: Flow
rule: The final Chain may return once at 50% effect.

name: Dilution
rule: Spend 20% new status Potency to remove 20% of another debuff Potency.

name: Confluence
rule: Convert half overheal to Shield, capped at 25% caster Max HP.

name: Undertow
rule: Water Pull applies Priority -10 to the next action.

name: Equalize
rule: Average selected status Potencies for at most four targets.

name: Foundation
rule: If unmoved since last action, output and Shield +20%.

name: Seismic
rule: Each prevented Push tile deals 5 Tenacity Damage, capped at 25.

name: Faultline
rule: Copy 30% Tremor Potency and Counter to at most two targets.

name: Bedrock
rule: Shield HP -25%; Resistance Scaling +50%.

name: Erosion
rule: Consecutive Earth hits gain 10% Tenacity Damage, capped at 50%.

name: Tailwind
rule: Each 10 Priority advantage grants 5% Push and speed, capped at 25%.

name: Slipstream
rule: Successful forced movement grants +15 Priority next action.

name: Ricochet
rule: A miss retargets once at 60% effect.

name: Vacuum
rule: Pull at most two projectiles or traps by two tiles.

name: Updraft
rule: Damage -50%; Push distance doubled.

name: Purification
rule: Spend 25% Heal to remove 25% of at most two debuff budgets.

name: Revelation
rule: Remove Invisible and apply Reveal Lock for 3 Counter.

name: Judgment
rule: Consume up to 20 enemy Buff Potency for up to +10% damage.

name: Sanctuary
rule: Share a positive Aura at 50% with at most three allies.

name: Absolution
rule: A full cleanse restores capped HP and Mana percentages.

name: Devour
rule: Consume up to 10 debuff Counter for up to +20% Drain.

name: Corruption
rule: Convert half removed Buff Potency into Curse, capped at 20.

name: Shadow Debt
rule: Weight and Mana -3 now; pay HP and Mana after three turns.

name: Usurpation
rule: On kill copy one Buff at 50% for three turns.

name: Eclipse
rule: Gain output according to the target's nearby ally count.

name: Toxic Catalyst
rule: Each distinct debuff adds 5% Poison tick Potency, capped at 50%.

name: Necrosis
rule: Convert 20% Poison tick to direct HP Damage; Potency -30%.

name: Anticoagulant
rule: Bleed advances Poison one tick and consumes one Poison Counter.

name: Reservoir
rule: Preserve half old Counter on higher-Potency replacement, capped at 20.

name: Compound
rule: One debuff loses 25% less Counter while Poison remains.

name: Permafrost
rule: Skip the first natural decay event.

name: Brittle
rule: Consume Counter for 10 Tenacity Damage, at most three times.

name: Cold Snap
rule: Consume up to three Counter for five Ice Damage each.

name: Cryostasis
rule: Freeze one status for exactly two turns.

name: Shatter
rule: Breaking Shield or Tenacity adds 25% broken value, capped at 30.

name: Echo
rule: Repeat the last Effect after two actions at 50%.

name: Resonance
rule: Consecutive same-spell hits gain 10% effect, capped at 30%.

name: Dissonance
rule: Double interruption power and deal 10 Sound Damage on success.

name: Harmonic
rule: Gain 5% effect per target, capped at 25%.

name: Feedback
rule: When interrupted, return half spent Mana and primary effect.

name: Magnetism
rule: Gain 10% force per 100 target equipment Weight, capped at 50%.

name: Sharpen
rule: Physical Damage -15%; Armor Penetration +25 points.

name: Temper
rule: Multiply Counter from armor Weight, capped at x2.

name: Shrapnel
rule: Create at most three secondary projectiles at 40%.

name: Forge Bond
rule: Blend 30% weapon Scaling with 70% magical Scaling.

name: Growth
rule: Gain 10% output per active turn, capped at 50%.

name: Root
rule: Prevented movement adds Binding Counter, capped at five.

name: Germination
rule: An untriggered Trap leaves one generation of child Traps.

name: Photosynthesis
rule: A surviving effect restores 5% Max Mana, capped at 10.

name: Propagation
rule: On death transfer 30% status or create a Trap.

name: Molten Ground
rule: Leave a two-tile area for three turns at 50% effect.

name: Obsidian
rule: On expiry leave a Trap at 40% effect and two Counter.

name: Melt Armor
rule: Consecutive hits reduce physical Defense up to 20%.

name: Viscosity
rule: Push -50%; Priority -10 and Movement -1 for two turns.

name: Eruption
rule: Consume object Counter for 5 damage each, capped at 50.

name: Conductor
rule: Form a six-member Electrified network for three turns.

name: Overload
rule: Consume up to three Counter for eight Lightning Damage each.

name: Arc Jump
rule: Prioritize non-Electrified targets; otherwise next jump -25%.

name: Grounding
rule: Against exactly one enemy, Counter +2 and Damage -20%.

name: Impulse
rule: Acting first grants 20% Chain and Electrified effect.

name: Staff Focus
rule: One Effect Node's Modifiers gain 25% efficiency, capped at 50%.

name: Grimoire Inscription
rule: Store at most three phrases and halve repeated repertoire cost.

name: Seal Imposition
rule: Improve one status budget exchange rate by 25%.
